heading: Divisions of Veterans Health Administration
lead: The Veterans Health Administration shall include the following:

tree.text: The Office of the Under Secretary for Health.
Such other professional and auxiliary services as the Secretary may find to be necessary to carry out the functions of the Administration.

notes.text: Amendments2013—Pars. (7), (8). Pub. L. 112–239 added par. (7) and redesignated former par. (7) as (8). 1992—Par. (1). Pub. L. 102–405 substituted “Under Secretary for Health” for “Chief Medical Director”.
